title: Name Printer
prompt:
Create a program that reads a user's first and last name and prints out a greeting message.
Sample Input: John Doe
Sample Output: Hello, John Doe!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you create a program that reads a user's first and last name and prints out a greeting message. Here's an example Python program that does this:
```python
# Get user's first name and last name
first_name = input("Please enter your first name: ")
last_name = input("Please enter your last name: ")

# Combine first and last name into a full name
full_name = f"{first_name} {last_name}"

# Print a greeting message
greeting_message = f"Hello, {full_name}!"
print(greeting_message)
```
When you run this program and enter "John" for the first name and "Doe" for the last name, it will output:
```
Hello, John Doe!
```
You can modify the input prompts and greeting message format to suit your needs.
